basis: renders a <div role="group"> — a labelled container of the ruler and user-supplied time bars; the ruler and each bar are role="img" elements the host names with an aria-label.

responsive.basis: geometry is percentage-based — bar position and width derive from the visible window alone, so the track scales trivially with any container width and has no viewport mechanism of its own; the harness specimen pins the proportions at one viewport.

harness.because: asserts bar proportion and aria-labels in browser, not the group's non-interactive matrix rows

exceptions.because: a track owns no focusable element — bars are role="img" elements with no tabindex and the window is host state, so the row's traversal contract reduces to the host's own controls
the pattern renders no focusable element — bars are role="img" divs with no tabindex — so there is nothing to obscure

interaction.basis: nothing in the pattern takes focus or a key: the bars are role="img" elements with no tabindex, the ruler is an aria-label over non-interactive geometry, and the window is host state — the track hosts nothing operable, by design.
